item.title: Outside, Dungeon, Town: Integrating the Three Places in Videogames (2024)
item.description:
📝 It is kind of good that you know you’re always safe in town. Developers do that so that players get a little “check box” feeling, that they have checked another Location off of the List Of Locations, and gotten that much closer to 100%-ing the game. Maybe there’s an underground part of it that is kind of a dungeon.
